title: Quite scratchy, very wrinkled after wash
text: Quite scratchy, very wrinkled after wash. I was glad to find these for this price, but they are quite scratchy and wrinkled badly after 1 wash. I am not going to worry about this because they are being used as a cover only. I will use a pillow case over these. I would not find these comfortable enough to use without a case.
